title: Binance Introduces the VIP Growth Program
text: This is a general announcement. Products and services referred to here may not be available in your region. Fellow Binancians, At Binance, we value every step of users’ journey. We’re excited to introduce our VIP Growth Program — a structured, progressive program designed to reward users’ commitment and loyalty with increasingly exclusive privileges, experiences, and rewards as they advance through the VIP levels. Whether you’re a rising star or an elite trader, every VIP level unlocks new opportunities tailored to enhance your trading experience and connect you with the wider crypto community. How It Works The VIP Growth Program is simple:  As the user’s trading volume and/or BNB holdings grow, they will be able to unlock higher VIP levels. With each new level, the user will gain access to more exclusive privileges and rewards. Key Definitions: Rewards are one-off gifts users receive when they first reach a specific VIP tier. Privileges refers to the access we grant to users when they reach certain VIP tiers. Users must maintain their VIP status to enjoy the privileges.  VIP Privileges and Rewards Overview VIP Level Privileges & Rewards VIP 1 VIP Portal: Access a dedicated portal on Binance.com with VIP-specific features to enhance trading experience Access to exclusive VIP newsletter Invitations to local events VIP Community Telegram Channel: Join an exclusive community space designed for VIPs to stay ahead with the latest Binance VIP updates, campaigns, and rewards  VIP 2 Invitation-only webinar on advanced Binance features and trends  VIP 3 Dedicated account manager and 24/7 Support Team  Reward: Binance Swag pack* (Silver tier) VIP 4 Product Clinic: Online sessions with VIP tech experts Invitation to private VIP events VIP 5 Free conference ticket to Binance Blockchain Week and a 1-on-1 personalized feedback session Reward: Binance Swag pack* (Gold tier) VIP 6 Invitation to the exclusive private VIP event Invitations to unique experiences (e.g., F1, concerts), subject to availability  VIP 7+ Opportunity to book 1-1 session with Binance executives Invitations to ultra-exclusive events and experiences  Reward: Binance Swag pack* (Diamond tier) Top-tier rewards with extraordinary perks * Only VIP users from participating regions shall be eligible to receive any merchandise or Binance Swag. How to Access Rewards & Privileges As users trade and/or grow their BNB holdings, their VIP levels will be automatically upgraded based on their activities. Users can check their trading volume and BNB holding requirements here. When a user gets upgraded to a new VIP tier, they will receive an email notification with details about their new benefits and any event invitations they are eligible for. In addition to the email, VIP 3 and above users will be contacted via in-app chat by their dedicated account manager and assist them to claim the eligible one-time rewards (such as Swag Packs), guide them through their new privileges, and arrange access to exclusive events and personalized services. Enjoy an exclusive Binance VIP experience seamlessly every step of the way! Thank you for your support! Binance Team 2025-06-13
